data.title: Speeding fine notice (Bußgeldbescheid) – €98.50
data.summary: The City of Musterau fines office (Bußgeldstelle) issued a fine notice dated 18 May 2026 for speeding 23 km/h over the limit on 30 April 2026. The total is €98.50 plus 1 point in the driving-fitness register.
data.explanation: You are accused of driving 93 km/h in a 70 km/h zone outside built-up areas. The fine is €70.00 plus €25.00 fees and €3.50 expenses, and you get 1 point. You may file an objection (Einspruch) in writing or on record at the fines office; the app shows the deadline, counted from the delivery date stamped on the envelope. Without a timely objection the decision becomes final and can be enforced. Payment is due within two weeks after it becomes final (Rechtskraft). If you are unsure whether to object, consider getting legal advice.
